title: Every day
description: Name the jobs you do at home, and say when you do them.
grammar: regular -ar verbs, and the words for a day at home
grammarNote: Every verb in this unit is a regular -ar verb, so they all work the way you already know.

explanation.summary: The last unit of A1 is a set of -ar verbs: the things you do around the house. It is a good place to finish, because everything here is a verb you can use straight away.

sections.heading: The verbs
sections.body: Barrer, planchar, lavar, doblar, fregar, cortar, nadar, pescar, pasear and visitar are all regular -ar verbs. You drop the -ar and add the ending of the person: yo barro, tú barres, él barre.

sections.heading: Every day
sections.body: These verbs take a thing, and the thing keeps its article: barro el suelo, lavo los platos, doblo la ropa. The word for the floor is el suelo, and the word for the washing is la ropa.

items.note: A regular -ar verb: barro, barres, barre.
